summary:
**Lunar Landing Site Navigator – AI-Powered Safe Landing Zone Selection**

Lunar Landing Site Navigator is an AI-powered decision-support platform designed to identify and evaluate safe landing locations on the Moon. We developed an integrated web application combining Geographic Information Systems (GIS), lunar terrain analysis, and intelligent site evaluation to help identify suitable landing zones.

The platform analyzes lunar Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to assess terrain characteristics such as slope, surface elevation, and potential landing hazards. It uses these parameters to identify safer candidate regions, rank potential landing sites, and present the results through an interactive map-based dashboard with visual analytics and detailed site information.

Our solution addresses the challenge of selecting safe lunar landing locations by transforming complex terrain data into understandable, data-driven recommendations. This is important because uneven terrain, steep slopes, and surface hazards can threaten spacecraft stability and mission success. By supporting faster and more informed landing-site decisions, our project contributes to safer, more reliable, and sustainable future lunar exploration.
details:
Lunar Landing Site Navigator is an interactive, GIS-powered platform developed to support the identification and evaluation of safer lunar landing locations.

The application processes lunar Digital Elevation Model (DEM) data and performs terrain-based analysis to evaluate potential landing regions. It considers important factors such as terrain slope, elevation variation, surface characteristics and potential landing hazards. A site-selection mechanism evaluates candidate locations and helps rank them based on their suitability.

The platform integrates a Python-based GIS backend using FastAPI with an interactive web frontend. Users can explore lunar terrain through a map-based interface, visualize analytical results, compare candidate landing locations and understand why certain regions may be more suitable than others.

Our creative approach is to transform complex lunar geospatial data into an accessible decision-support system rather than simply displaying terrain maps. The solution aims to support safer spacecraft landing decisions, reduce exposure to terrain-related risks and contribute to future lunar exploration.

Technologies: Python, FastAPI, GIS, lunar DEM data, terrain analysis, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and interactive mapping technologies.

The project considers terrain safety, data availability, landing suitability, visualization clarity and the importance of transparent, explainable site evaluation.
